description: Guardian plugin default configuration. Override with ~/.config/claude-code/guardian.json (global) or .claude/guardian.json (project-specific)

testVerification.description: Ensures tests have been run before allowing commits. Disabled by default - enable in project config with project-specific test commands.
testVerification.comment_skipInRemote: Skip in remote Claude Code sessions (limited resources)

testCommands.description: Patterns to recognize valid test commands in transcript
testCommands.comment_local: Add patterns like: {'pattern': '^pytest\b', 'name': 'pytest'} or {'pattern': '^npm test', 'name': 'npm test'}
testCommands.comment_remote: Lighter commands for remote sessions, e.g. linting only

testVerification.comment_environmentSelector: Environment variable to check for remote vs local (true = remote)
testVerification.comment_triggerCommands: Commands that trigger the test verification check
testVerification.comment_excludeFromTestRequirement: Files that don't require tests (docs, config, etc)

testReportFallback.description: If transcript doesn't show test run, check for test report file
testReportFallback.comment_transcriptStaleThreshold: Seconds - how old transcript can be before requiring fresh test run

preCommitReview.description: Pre-commit workflow: format, lint, run pre-commit hooks, and LLM code review
preCommitReview.comment_skipInRemote: Skip in remote sessions (LLM review is expensive)
preCommitReview.comment_triggers: Which commands trigger the pre-commit review workflow

workflow.comment_executeGitAdds: Execute any 'git add' commands found in the commit command
workflow.comment_stashUnstaged: Stash unstaged changes to isolate what's being committed

runFormatLint.comment_enabled: Disabled by default. Enable in project config and configure tools.
runFormatLint.comment_usePlugin: If true, use format-and-lint plugin if available, otherwise fall back to repo script
runFormatLint.comment_repoScriptPath: Path to repo-specific format script (relative to repo root)

runPreCommitHooks.description: Run pre-commit framework hooks if .pre-commit-config.yaml exists
runPreCommitHooks.comment_maxIterations: Max iterations when hooks modify files (prevents infinite loops)

runCodeReview.description: LLM-based code review using bundled review-changes.py script
runCodeReview.comment_enabled: Disabled by default (expensive). Enable in project config. Requires OPENROUTER_KEY or configured llm model.
runCodeReview.comment_cacheKeyLength: Length of cache key prefix for 'Reviewed: cache-XXXX' sentinel

bypassMechanisms.comment_reviewedSentinel: Add to commit message to acknowledge minor issues
bypassMechanisms.comment_bypassSentinel: Add to commit message to escalate blocking issues to user
bypassMechanisms.comment_requireBypassForBlocking: Require 'Bypass-Review' with reason for blocking issues

stopValidation.description: Validation checks when Claude Code session stops
stopValidation.comment_enabled: Disabled by default - very strict. Enable per-project if desired.
stopValidation.comment_returnCode: Exit code when validation fails (2 = error)

formatAndLint.description: Run format/lint commands before session end
formatAndLint.comment_commands: Project-specific format/lint commands, e.g. ['npm run format', 'npm run lint']

validation.comment_uncommittedChanges: How to handle uncommitted changes: 'ignore', 'warn', or 'error'
validation.comment_unpushedCommits: How to handle unpushed commits: 'ignore', 'warn', or 'error'

testVerification.description: How to handle missing test runs. Leverages the same logic as the pre-commit test verification hook.
testVerification.comment_level: Behavior on failure: 'warn' or 'error'. Note: This check uses the main 'testVerification' section for its core configuration (test commands, excludes, etc.).

validation.comment_checkRequestFulfilled: Warn if user request doesn't appear to be fulfilled

oneshotMode.comment_allowFailureFile: If this file exists, allow failure with reason from file
